question:
Choose the most suitable one-word substitution for the following.

One who takes part in an activity for pleasure and not professionally.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3 i.e. Amateur**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Amateur"** refers to someone who engages in an activity purely for pleasure, not professionally. (शौकिया)
 
 
• **Example:** He plays football as an amateur, not as a professional player.
 
 
• An amateur is driven by passion or interest rather than earning a livelihood from the activity. (शौक के कारण कार्य करने वाला)
 
 
• **Example:** She enjoys painting as an amateur artist in her free time.
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3 i.e. Amateur**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Novice** (नवशिक्षित): Refers to someone who is new or inexperienced in a particular field.
 
 
• **Example:** As a novice in cooking, he struggled to make a simple dish.
 
 
 
• **Apprentice** (शागिर्द): A person who is learning a trade or skill from a skilled employer, typically for a fixed period.
 
 
• **Example:** He worked as an apprentice carpenter to learn the craft.
 
 
 
• **Veteran** (अनुभवी): Refers to someone who has significant experience or has served for a long time in a particular field.
 
 
• **Example:** The veteran soldier shared his war stories with the younger recruits.
